text:
Maya: Pagerbot paged me for eu-west3 GPU pool drop (degraded capacity). Failover to eu-west1 kicked but traffic shift got rate-limited by the cooldown window. Thinking we should tweak pagerbot priority/window for cross-region failovers.
Sam: Can you paste the pagerbot alert payload or the rule id? want to see which condition fired.
Maya: rule id `fabric.capacity.low_v2`. payload: `instances_unavailable: 18, cpu_util: 92%, queued_jobs: 120, recent_evictions: 3`
Maya: Current config: `failover_cooldown_seconds: 300` and `priority_window_seconds: 120`. In practice eu-west3 dips are short but frequent so 300s prevents immediate mitigation. Proposing `failover_cooldown_seconds: 90` + keep `priority_window_seconds: 180` so humans still get a heads-up.
OncallBot: Automated action executed: initiated canary shift to eu-west1 with 15% of traffic (runbook link: https://redwood/runbooks/failover).
Tess: Lowering cooldown to 90s sounds fine for GPU pools, but risk of flapping. Suggest adding a debounce: only allow failover if sustained for 45s within the 90s window (i.e., 3 checks).
Ralph: Agree with Tess. Also add a cost note — cross-region egress + burst GPUs will raise unit cost. We should gate automatic full-shift to non-business hours unless the anomaly is severe (eviction_count > 5).
Sam: Quick check: how many requests hit the canary? logs show `canary_requests: 520` in last 5m, error rate down 0.6% -> looks stable.
Maya: TL;DR proposed change: 1) `failover_cooldown_seconds: 90` 2) debounce: require sustained alert for 45s (3/5 checks) 3) escalate full traffic shift only if evictions >= 5 OR sustained for >10m. 4) add pager notification to on-call and next-level on sustained.
Pagerbot: Note: staging rule updated with proposed values. Will roll to prod after +1 from oncall rotation.
Ralph: +1 but ensure there's an auto-backoff: if we flip >2 times in 1h revert to manual.
Tess: Add a short handoff checklist to the bot message for outgoing oncall: `1) summary, 2) mitigations run, 3) next steps + playbook link, 4) cost delta` — make it a template the bot posts at handoff.
Maya: I'll draft the handoff template and a short JSON patch for Pagerbot. Pasting snippet: ```
{
  "alert_rule": "fabric.capacity.low_v2",
  "failover_cooldown_seconds": 90,
  "debounce_checks_required": 3,
  "full_shift_conditions": "evictions>=5 OR sustained_minutes>=10",
  "auto_revert_threshold": "flips>2_in_1h"
}
```
Sam: Can you also add a flag `allow_cross_region_auto_shift: false` for enterprise customers?
Maya: Good call, will make that a customer-tier gate.
OncallBot: Reminder: Handoff template will be posted automatically when current oncall marks `handoff-in-progress`. Use `/oncall handoff` to trigger.
